answer: The ferrous register is checked at draw time, zenith lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 89 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 89 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
